concept.title: All season tires
concept.shortdesc: Kia specifies all season tires on some models to provide good performance for use all year round, including for snowy and icy road conditions.

keywords.indexterm: tires and wheels all season tires

conbody.p: All season tires are identified by ALL SEASON or M+S (Mud and Snow) on the tire sidewall. Snow tires have better snow traction than all season tires and may be more appropriate in some areas.
